public.text: Describing the reference architecture as an “authoritative reference point” could imply that countries are expected to conform normatively to every element, whereas the document later describes it as adaptable and non-prescriptive.
public.suggestedRevision: Replace “authoritative reference point” with “common reference point,” or clarify the extent to which the architecture is intended to be normative.
